title: High molecular weight bacterial DNA extraction from fecal samples for long-read sequencing
author: Amandine Magdeleine
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvyin7ue

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: Incubate Buffer SL1 for 5 min at 50 °C before use and add 100 mL of 96 % ethanol to Buffer SW2 before use.

steps.title: Weigh and wash fecal sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 500–700 mg feces into a 2 mL LoBind tube, centrifuge 5 min at full speed, discard the ethanol supernatant and repeat the wash five times. Weigh the remaining fecal material (300–500 mg), transfer it to a NucleoSpin MN Bead Tube Type A and add 700 µL Buffer SL1.

steps.title: Lyse sample and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Enhancer SX, vortex horizontally at full speed for 5 min, centrifuge 2 min at 12.8 rpm, transfer ~600 µL supernatant to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube and keep the pellet at 4 °C for the second extraction. Add 150 µL Buffer SL3, vortex 5 sec, incubate 10 min at 0–4 °C, then centrifuge 1 min at 12.8 rpm.

steps.title: Remove inhibitors
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant onto a NucleoSpin Inhibitor Removal Column (red ring) in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge 1 min at 12.8 rpm, repeat with the remaining supernatant, then add 250 µL Buffer SB and vortex 5 sec.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Transfer 550 µL of supernatant onto a NucleoSpin Soil Column (green ring) in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge 1 min at 12.8 rpm, discard the flow‑through, replace the collection tube and repeat with the remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Wash silica membrane
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer SB, centrifuge 30 sec at 12.8 rpm, discard liquid, add 550 µL Buffer SW1, centrifuge 30 sec at 12.8 rpm, discard, add 700 µL Buffer SW2, vortex 2 sec, centrifuge 30 sec at 12.8 rpm, discard, repeat the Buffer SW2 wash, then discard again.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 2 min at 12.8 rpm to dry the silica membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first extraction)
steps.instruction: Place the NucleoSpin Soil Column in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 60 µL Buffer SE, incubate 1 min at room temperature with the lid open, then centrifuge 30 sec at 12.8 rpm.

steps.title: Perform second extraction
steps.instruction: Retrieve the pellet kept in the fridge, add 700 µL Buffer SL1 and 150 µL Buffer SX, vortex to resuspend, then repeat the lysis, inhibitor removal, DNA binding, washing and drying steps (steps 3–7).

steps.title: Elute DNA (second extraction)
steps.instruction: Place the column in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 35 µL Buffer SE, incubate 1 min at room temperature with the lid open, and centrifuge 30 sec at 12.8 rpm.

steps.title: Quantify DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer (Broad Range) and a NanoDrop spectrophotometer; the Qubit/NanoDrop ratio must be between 0.6 and 1. Check fragment size by running 1 % agarose gel in 1× TAE.

steps.title: Bead‑based size selection
steps.instruction: Adjust bead volume to DNA volume × ratio (0.4–1×). Resuspend the pellet by gently shaking, briefly centrifuge, incubate 10 min at room temperature, prepare fresh 70 % ethanol, place tube on a magnetic rack for 4 min, remove supernatant, add 200 µL 70 % ethanol, wait 30 sec and discard; repeat the ethanol wash, briefly centrifuge, return to magnetic rack, remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, remove tube from rack, air‑dry 1 min at room temperature, add 55 µL H₂O, resuspend, incubate 10 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, transfer the cleared supernatant to a new LoBind tube, and quantify DNA again with Qubit and NanoDrop.

steps.title: Prepare ONT sequencing library
steps.instruction: Follow the Oxford Nanopore Technologies 1D Genomic DNA by Ligation (SQK‑LSK109) kit instructions to construct the library; quantify the final library with Qubit (Broad Range).

steps.title: Load library onto MinION
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto a MinION or Mk1C device using an R9 flowcell and run the sequencing experiment.
